title: Proof Broker adapter capability manifest (spec v1.0 §7.4, App. A.7)
description: Declared capabilities of a backend adapter. The dispatcher matches goal classification against this manifest before invoking the adapter (failures yield 'logic_out_of_fragment' / 'type_construction_not_supported').

adapter.description: Adapter identifier; matches the 'adapter' field on emitted refinement records.

backends_supported.description: Backend identities this adapter targets (e.g. ['cvc5'], ['vampire-hol', 'vampire-fol']). Optional; defaults to [adapter].

logic_fragments.description: Fragment ids the adapter can dispatch into. Drawn from the registry's first-order fragments list plus 'FOL'/'HOL'.

type_constructions.description: Construction kinds the adapter handles, plus pseudo-values such as 'type_variable_via_specialization' (handles type variables only when a specialization is recorded).

max_order.description: Highest order of quantification the adapter handles.

trace_formats_produced.description: Trace format ids the adapter emits at Tier 3 (e.g. 'alethe-2024', 'tstp-fof', 'tstp-thf', 'lean-tactic-script', 'lfsc'). Required iff tiers_produced contains 3.

witness_kinds_produced.description: Witness kinds the adapter emits at Tier 1 (e.g. 'farkas', 'sat_assignment', 'sat_unsat_core'). Required iff tiers_produced contains 1.

preferred_rewrite_pipeline.description: Pipeline the adapter wants applied to the IR before consumption (spec §5.4).

concurrency.description: Hints for the dispatcher's concurrent-dispatch policy.
